full_judgment: 6. In the result, the rule is made absolute and the judgment and order passed by the learned S.C.C. Judge is set aside. The S.C.C. suit is hereby decreed and the plaintiff shall get khas possession of the suit premises after evicting the defendant-tenant in accordance with law. There will be no order as to costs.
